'''Varas Hoorst''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He operated a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] repair shop in the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]], employing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Rroggerr]] and the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Vinda (Zabrak)|Vinda]] as mechanics. He was an associate of a group of [[Thaereian military]] agents who traveled to Cularin to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Gavid Lermyn]].
